recentItems.title: After Trump's Warning To Iran, Russian, Chinese & UAE Aircraft Land In Pakistan | War Tension Mounts
recentItems.description:
Tensions between the US and Iran are drawing fresh attention after Russian, Chinese and UAE military aircraft reportedly landed in Pakistan. The reported movements of military cargo planes have fuelled speculation over Pakistan's possible role in a potential US strike on Iran, with claims that Washington could use Pakistan's Nur Khan Air Base for an operation. The developments come after Donald Trump issued a warning to Tehran following Iran's 'surrender' message. However, neither the alleged US plan nor the purpose of the aircraft movements has been officially confirmed.

recentItems.description:

Meghan joined Prince Harry at an online child safety event at the European Parliament in Brussels. Although she was scheduled to deliver a speech, she reportedly pulled out, with Harry expected to address the gathering later. The arrest is linked to alleged material found in storage units in California.

recentItems.title: WARNING: SCARY VISUALS! Stone-Pelting In Himachal Village, Ritual To Offer Blood To Goddess Kali
recentItems.description:
A centuries-old ritual turned intense in Himachal Pradesh's Dhami village as crowds gathered for the 400-year-old 'Patthar Ka Khel' fair. Celebrated a day after Diwali, the unusual tradition involves two groups pelting stones at each other until someone is injured. A few drops of the participant's blood are then offered to Goddess Bhadrakali. The ritual is believed to have replaced the ancient practice of human sacrifice.
